observed_value: fair_value_currency flagged as U_GBP/U_EUR on six rows
anchor_value: Source schedule places GBP/EUR symbols under Principal/Shares, not Market Value; fair value should remain USD-denominated

findings.detail: The parser appears to assign the Principal/Shares currency symbol to fair_value_currency for non-USD loan rows; Market Value is a separate column.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 single-field currency-unit flag. Raw schedule coordinates show the non-USD symbols are positioned in the Principal/Shares column before the principal/share amount, while Cost and Market Value are distinct columns to the right. Therefore the stored fair_value_currency values U_GBP/U_EUR are not supported for the fair value field; the extraction has leaked the principal currency into fair_value_currency.
